summary: Iteration 47 fully green — 8/8 backend pytest cases pass on the promotion enhancement stack, and all 5 frontend UI flows for the rebuilt PromotionDialog verified end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend: POST /api/promotions echoes the full new shape (pricingMode, bundlePrice, categories, minQuantity/maxQuantity, stackable, products); PUT accepts partial updates for all new fields and they persist across GET; GET /api/promotions returns all rows including the new fields with no 500 on legacy rows (safe_parse_list). /api/v26/cart/apply-promos returns pricingMode='fixed_price', bundlePrice, originalTotal, discount = originalTotal-bundlePrice and savingsPct for fixed-price bundles; percentage promos still return pricingMode='percentage' and percentage discount (no regression); categories OR products filter correctly OR-matches — a promo with categories:['TESTMainsCat47'] fired when only one cart line had that category; minQuantity gate correctly blocks the promo when the matching cart has fewer than minQuantity items. Frontend: /products → Promotions tab → Create Promotion opens the rebuilt dialog (data-testid promo-dialog) with all three type selectors (promo-type-category/bundle/mixed) and both pricing selectors (promo-mode-percentage/fixed). Clicking Fixed Bundle Price reveals promo-bundle-price-input, promo-min-qty, promo-max-qty and hides promo-discount-input. With bundlePrice=25 and 3 items totalling $28.74 selected, the emerald promo-bundle-preview shows '$28.74 $25.00 Save $3.74 · 13% off'. Type='mixed' shows BOTH the categories chip strip AND the individual items list simultaneously. Saved promo card renders '$25.00 for 3+' for the fixed-price bundle and '20% OFF' for the percentage promo (data-testid promo-price-{id}).

issues: Radix DialogContent still missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby — same non-blocking a11y warning reported in iter 46 for other dialogs. No functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: models/promotion.py cleanly extends the Promotion + PromotionCreate models with pricingMode, bundlePrice, categories, minQuantity, maxQuantity, stackable — sensible defaults ('percentage', None) preserve back-compat, and safe_parse_list wraps every GET row through the Pydantic model so legacy rows automatically get the new fields materialised in the response.

routes/transactions.py: PUT /promotions/{id} uses an explicit `allowed` whitelist that now includes every new field (pricingMode, bundlePrice, categories, minQuantity, maxQuantity, stackable). Correctly pops _id from the return object. Good defensive pattern.

routes/v26_commerce.py apply_promos_to_cart branches cleanly on pricingMode. Fixed-price computation uses max(0, rel_subtotal - bundle_price) so it never returns a negative discount. Category+product OR match logic is symmetric and correctly falls back to whole-cart when no filters are set. minQuantity gate implemented as a hard skip. bug-worthy edge: `if p.get('minQuantity') and qty_total < int(p['minQuantity'])` — a minQuantity of 0 is falsy and will bypass the gate, which is the desired behaviour (0 = no gate). Correct.

PromotionDialog.jsx rebuild is well-scoped (~317 lines). Multi-select category chips + item checkbox list + bundle preview useMemo are all self-contained. useState for itemSearch is local to the dialog. All interactive elements carry data-testid attributes per the iteration testids doc.

Products.jsx makeEmptyPromo, openEditPromo, savePromo correctly carry new fields including a null-vs-empty-string guard on bundlePrice (`promoForm.bundlePrice === '' || promoForm.bundlePrice == null ? null : parseFloat(...)`) — this prevents NaN on save. Card display switches on isFixed = pricingMode === 'fixed_price' and renders the correct badge shape.

MINOR: Products.jsx is now 691 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline threshold. Consider extracting the promotion card render (~lines 470-555) into a small PromotionCard component alongside PromotionDialog for maintainability in future iterations.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 flows: dialog opens with all selectors, fixed mode shows bundle/min/max + hides %, live emerald preview renders correctly, mixed shows cats+items simultaneously, card badges render '$25.00 for 3+' vs '20% OFF')

seed_data_creation: During the pytest run, ~6 TEST_iter47_* promotions are created and torn down via a module-scoped fixture teardown → no orphans. During the frontend flow the 'TEST_iter47 UI Bundle' (fixed_price) and 'TEST_iter47 UI Pct' (percentage) promos were created and deleted at the end via the delete-promo-{id} button, verified via toast + row disappearance. Note: an existing pre-seeded 'Family Feast' bundle promotion (fixed-price $25.00 for 3+) is present in DB as reference — untouched.

(2) POST/PUT /api/promotions accept + persist all new fields; GET returns them via safe_parse_list wrap. (4) PromotionDialog.jsx rebuilt as a 317-line component with type selector (category|bundle|mixed), pricing selector (percentage|fixed_price), multi-select category chips, item search+checkbox list, min/max qty inputs, live emerald bundle preview, stackable toggle, and active toggle. (5) Products.jsx card display switches on isFixed. Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration47_promotions.py (8 cases).
